fields.name: form_name
fields.description: Name or identifier of the tax form (W-9, 1099-MISC, 941, 1120, etc.).

fields.name: tax_year_or_period
fields.description: Tax year or reporting period covered by the form.

fields.name: taxpayer_name
fields.description: Name of the individual or business submitting the form.

fields.name: taxpayer_identification_number
fields.description: Employer Identification Number (EIN) or Social Security Number (SSN).

fields.name: address
fields.description: Mailing address of the taxpayer or entity.

fields.name: form_specific_details
examples: W-9: Certification of TIN. 1099: Non-employee comp. 941: Q2 payroll taxes, etc.
fields.description: Key fields or line items unique to each form type.

fields.name: signature
fields.description: Authorized signatory acknowledging the form’s accuracy.

fields.name: date_signed
fields.description: When the taxpayer or representative signed the form.

fields.name: submission_date
fields.description: When the form was filed or submitted (if known).

fields.name: comments
examples: Filed electronically via IRS e-file system.
fields.description: Any additional remarks relevant to the form filing.

document.document_description: Various U.S. tax forms used for business or contractor reporting, payroll tax returns, and corporate income tax filings. Examples include W-9 for taxpayer identification, 1099 for reporting income to contractors, 941 for quarterly payroll taxes, and 1120 for corporate income tax returns.
